description: Supersets are exercises next to each other that share a group number (workout_exercises.superset_group). The rest timer only starts after a set of the last exercise of a superset. Groups are listed in exercise order; null means not in a superset.

supersetWithNext.note: two loose exercises get a new group
the next one joins this one's group
this one joins the next one's group
the last exercise has no next

removeFromSuperset.note: the group goes away when one is left
